name: ViZDoom
summary: 基于 Doom 的第一人称视觉强化学习环境，提供可控动作和帧序列。
summaryEn: A Doom-based first-person visual RL environment with controllable actions and frame sequences.
scaleZh: 多个可配置第一人称场景
verdict: 视觉动作预测游戏环境
wmNote: 像素观测与动作接口适合学习环境转移。
wmNoteEn: Pixel observations and action APIs support transition learning.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1605.02097] ViZDoom: A Doom-based AI Research Platform for Visual Reinforcement Learning
evidence.statement: Customizable first-person Doom scenarios expose visual observations to bots executing actions; environment generator, not a fixed corpus.
